rationale: The papers on the stellar rotation-activity relationship (1807.03304), coherent radio bursts (1810.00855), magnetic fields on brown dwarfs (1808.02485), and magnetospheric radio emission from Y dwarfs (s2) provide evidence related to the magnetic behavior of objects near the cooler end of the stellar main sequence, but do not fully resolve the question.
